incidents.name: FloorStaking stake/unstake supply accounting
incidents.notes: FloorStaking's stake()/unstake() converted between FLOOR and gFLOOR using sFLOOR's rebase index while the index was computed from a circulating supply the staker had just changed, so repeating the round trip with flash-loaned FLOOR minted more FLOOR each pass.

sources.ref: onchain review: FloorStaking 0x759c6De5bcA9ADE8A1a2719a31553c4B7DE02539 created 2022-02-27T21:34:11Z by 0x93db3662e5e77a3ef6be5d32192f070554f212d1, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (554.4 days). ~40 ETH x $1,621.94 at incidentTimestamp 1693898711 (DefiLlama) = $64,878.
